plans.idea: Product-first strip: the bottle anchors the left edge, the headline-led copy block reads across the middle, and the brand lockup sits stacked over the 'Taste the Glow' pill on the right as the end-of-read action.
Classic brand-to-action banner: the Solstice lockup leads at the far left, the headline block sits in the middle, and the bottle and its CTA pill close the strip together on the right.
Headline-led reading order: 'Pure gold.' opens at the left, the logo sits over the CTA pill in one centred brand-and-action column, and the bottle closes the right edge as the product payoff.
